description: Legal record (#123) in a court register/pinqas from a Karaite beit din in Cairo (on f. 40v of Yevr.-Arab. I 328). Dated: 28 Sivan 5329 AM (1569 CE). Avraham the elder (ha-zaqen) b. Manṣūr al-Fūlādī acknowledges that he owes a debt of 20 ashrafi in the form of a charitable loan to ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Levi. MCD.
description_he: מסמך משפטי ביהודית-ערבית. מוחזק בהספרייה הלאומית רוסיה.
